claims.text: The Assembly news notice created 24 December 2024 reports that the Legislative Assembly elected Hon. Dr. 'Aisake Valu Eke (Tongatapu 5) as Prime Minister Designate with 16 votes to 8 for Dr. Viliami Uasike Latu, following the resignation of former Prime Minister Hu'akavameiliku, who stepped down on 9 December; that the Speaker announced the result after it was presented to King Tupou VI; and that Parliament adjourned until further notice as the nation awaited formal confirmation of Eke's leadership.
claims.uncertainty: Corroborates the minutes. 'Awaits the formal confirmation' confirms that no royal appointment had been made by then; it dates none.
